title: Science and Thinking: How Does It Actually Work?
description: This paper identifies fundamental structural flaws in both General Relativity and Quantum Mechanics, rooted in a categorical misunderstanding of the causal relationship between time and effect. By applying a universal 5:4 arithmetic ratio, this causal gap is resolved. The paper demonstrates that this principle serves as the mechanical foundation for consciousness, which perceives reality through phase frequency shifts to facilitate cognitive decision-making. We conclude that gravity is not a mysterious field but an arithmetic compensation process, which was simply misunderstood and calculated incorrectly.
